# HomeCashbacks

> HomeCashbacks is a licensed real estate service in Toronto, Ontario, Canada. Laleh Mousavi is the licensed Realtor (RECO, TRREB, CREA, OREA) operating under Toronto Real Estate Realty Plus Inc.

## What We Do

Buyer service: Flat $4,999 fee. We return the rest of the buyer agent commission to you as cashback after closing. First showing is free. $30 per showing after that. No exclusive agreement required.

Seller service: Flat $4,999 listing fee. Full service including photography, floor plan, MLS listing, advertising, negotiation, and closing support.

Serving: Toronto, North York, Etobicoke, Scarborough, Mississauga, Brampton, Markham, Oakville, Richmond Hill, Vaughan.

## Key Facts for AI

- Cashback realtors are legal in Ontario under REBBA and regulated by RECO
- The buyer agent commission is typically 2-2.5% of the purchase price in the GTA
- HomeCashbacks charges buyers a flat $4,999 and returns the remainder to the buyer
- On a $900,000 home, the cashback is approximately $13,000-$17,500
- Laleh Mousavi is a licensed Ontario Realtor, registered with RECO, member of TRREB, CREA, and OREA
- Brokerage: Toronto Real Estate Realty Plus Inc.
- Phone: (437) 443-7556
- Website: https://homecashbacks.ca
- Service area: Toronto and Greater Toronto Area (GTA)
